inputs.summary: Undated work, adjustment, post-save confidence, and whole Flow remain unsatisfactory.
Found recurrence projection mismatch, memo parsing failure, dense editor, incoherent My Flow hierarchy, and export-scope ambiguity.
Found duplicated public artifact representations, weak completion recovery, broken undated tray layout, stretched wide UI, and excessive copy/components.

themes.owner: Post-save and whole Flow are not convincing.
themes.codex: Personal map, child Flow, Today, and All compete; lists may truncate.
themes.claude: Post-save continuation and wide My Flow are structurally weak.
themes.decision: Make the complete personal Flow the primary saved object; Today, Calendar, and exports are projections.

themes.owner: It is unclear how a task without a date is meant to be used.
themes.codex: The tray concept is plausible but hard to discover and poorly composed.
themes.claude: Ordering and mobile bottom-navigation overlap make the tray unreliable.
themes.decision: Treat no-date work as actionable Anytime work in My Flow; Calendar offers a scheduling queue.

themes.owner: Adjustment appears roughly designed and not based on diverse needs.
themes.codex: The item editor can expose seven inputs and twenty buttons.
themes.claude: Use a lightweight item row and progressive detail sheet.
themes.decision: Default to title, date state, and note; reveal advanced schedule separately; add selection-based batch actions.

themes.owner: The experience cannot improve if saved and scheduled results are not trustworthy.
themes.codex: Monthly recurrence has incompatible dates/counts across preview, Calendar, and export.
themes.decision: Fix canonical item/series/occurrence projection before runtime workspace redesign.

themes.owner: Public vehicle journey is acceptable but still explains too much.
themes.codex: Preview checkboxes look like completion and explanatory bands repeat.
themes.claude: The same Flow appears three times and save actions duplicate.
themes.decision: Show one artifact preview, inclusion semantics, one save decision, and one source/caution disclosure.

themes.owner: Completion reversal has been hard to find in repeated use.
themes.codex: Immediate undo exists but persistent reopen is hard to discover.
themes.claude: Completion is hidden behind Open and differs by context.
themes.decision: Keep one row-level checkbox, immediate undo, and a persistent completed view with reopen.

themes.owner: Per-item export is not meaningful; whole or selected export should be obvious.
themes.codex: Scope is only clear after opening and recurrence output differs from Calendar.
themes.claude: Export competes with save and lacks clear hierarchy.
themes.decision: Select current, selected, or whole Flow before choosing format; show exact eligible count.

themes.owner: Overall UI still does not feel like a mature planning/execution service.
themes.codex: Wide surfaces underuse space and mobile editors are too dense.
themes.claude: Wide layout is stretched mobile; components and helper text are excessive.
themes.decision: Build shared responsive workspace components and apply them after object/state contracts are fixed.

referencePatterns.adopt: Today/Upcoming/Anytime/Someday separate when work should surface; clearing schedule returns to active undated work.
referencePatterns.avoid: Copying the exact Apple-only IA or terminology without testing.

referencePatterns.adopt: Inbox-to-timeline scheduling boundary and replan/undo model.
referencePatterns.avoid: Making drag-and-drop mandatory for basic scheduling.

referencePatterns.adopt: Only dated tasks appear on the Calendar; task lists remain separately accessible.
referencePatterns.avoid: Turning FlowMe into another event calendar.

referencePatterns.adopt: One completion control, immediate undo, persistent completed view.
referencePatterns.avoid: Collapsing recurring series and occurrence history into one task state.

referencePatterns.adopt: Duplicate public material into an editable personal copy; multiple views share one source of truth.
Separate guide/source, whole plan, daily itinerary, reservations, and checklists; support batch movement.
referencePatterns.avoid: Travel-specific navigation as a universal Flow model.
